dedupe_keys.name: rrt lithuania mobile internet quality measurements on cities roads and railways 2g 3g 4g

description: The Communications Regulatory Authority of Lithuania measures the quality of wireless internet access services provided by mobile operators in different parts of the country and publishes the results as two open datasets. The first covers measurements in cities and along roads, and the second along railway lines. Each measurement records the network technology (2G, 3G or 4G) and the quality of the data service observed by the regulator's test equipment, with the city and road file covering the 2019 and 2020 campaigns. The datasets were first published in March 2023 and were last touched on the portal in December 2025. Coverage: Lithuanian cities, main roads and railways. Format and access: CSV files served from the regulator's opendata.rrt.lt host and listed on data.gov.lt, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the campaigns are dated, with no 5G; the file link for the city and road campaign returned a not-found error when checked, so the files may have moved; exact fields and row counts were not checked. Simulation uses: measured speed and technology along transport corridors for Lithuanian service models, and a check on operator-declared coverage. Related records: the RRT mobile operator coverage rasters give declared coverage; the Czech railway corridor mobile coverage and the CTU mobile signal measurements give comparable drive and rail measurements.
name: RRT Lithuania mobile internet quality measurements on cities, roads and railways (2G, 3G, 4G)
notes: Metadata read through the data.europa.eu search API on 2026-09-26. opendata.rrt.lt/static/Matavimai-2G-3G-4G-2019-2020.csv returned HTTP 404 to a HEAD request; the railway file was not tried. The measurement method is inferred from the dataset titles.
